Bihar Floods: Central Team to Visit, Relief Efforts Underway

A central team is scheduled to visit Bihar on September 16 to assess the flood situation, which has affected nearly 50 lakh people. Ahead of this visit, Bihar Chief Minister transferred ₹579 crore in flood relief funds. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has urged for swift relief measures for those impacted by the floods.
